targets.gateImpact: materially narrows and likely removes the stated dilution/convertible sub-gates; Chief should verify whether any separate governance normalization remains methodology-required before promotion

findings.statement: Teradyne's FY2025 10-K reports 156,555,950 common shares outstanding as of 2026-02-16 and 3,050,235 shares available for issuance under the 2006 Equity Plan as of 2025-12-31. The filing also reports 1,634,922 RSUs excluded from the weighted-average exercise-price calculation.

The 2025 proxy states the 2025 amendment/restatement did not increase the number of shares authorized under the 2006 Plan, preventing an incorrect assumption that the plan renewal itself added a new authorization pool.

The legacy 1.25% convertible senior notes matured on 2023-12-15. Associated warrant transactions continued expiring only through 2024; the 2024 Q2 filing describes the remaining warrant tail and expiry through 2024. This legacy convertible complex should not be treated as current 2026 convertible debt capacity.

Teradyne's 2026 Q1 10-Q says cash, cash equivalents, marketable securities and its senior secured revolving credit facility are expected to cover working-capital/expenditure needs for at least twelve months and that it was in compliance with all Credit Agreement covenants at 2026-03-29.

targets.contradictionStatus: none; evidence corrects the possible stale inference that the 2016 convertible notes remain a current financing instrument
targets.nextBestSourcePath: If Chief still requires exact current revolver utilization/debt balance rather than liquidity sufficiency, use Note I/debt and Credit Agreement tables in the 2026 Q1 10-Q; do not reopen legacy convertible research.

targets.gateImpact: fully resolves the named customer-concentration sub-gate with primary evidence; end-market concentration is characterized, while governance/capital-allocation remains a separate gate

findings.statement: Powell's FY2025 10-K explicitly states that no single customer accounted for more than 10% of consolidated revenue in either fiscal 2025 or fiscal 2024.

The same 10-K warns that revenue can be concentrated in a few large project contracts and identifies significant end-market concentration in oil & gas, petrochemical and electric utility industries; facility-level customer concentration can also be material even though consolidated single-customer concentration stayed below 10%.

targets.contradictionStatus: none; consolidated customer diversification and project/end-market concentration coexist and should not be conflated
targets.nextBestSourcePath: For the remaining governance/capital-allocation gate, use Powell's latest definitive proxy plus FY2025 capital-return/acquisition disclosures; do not repeat customer-concentration research.

summary: Two exact b03 gates were materially narrowed without opening optional research debt. TER's current dilution pool is quantified and the legacy convertible complex is confirmed expired; POWL's consolidated customer-concentration gate is resolved below 10% while project/end-market concentration remains explicitly characterized. Chief should consume these as promotion-enabling sub-gate resolutions, not as score/rank changes.
